objects: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas, NOT a mockup. Generate ONE square 4x4 equal-cell sprite sheet of 16 isolated dark fantasy dungeon props, matching the attached charcoal masonry pixel art reference. Reference is style only. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard painted in, no floor tiles, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Every sprite entirely within its own equal cell with 12% transparent margin, grounded consistently at 82% cell height. Orthographic top-down RPG perspective with a little front face, never isometric diamonds. Crisp chunky pixel art designed to read at logical 32x32, restrained detail, warm grey outlines, dark low saturation materials, warm amber fire. Row 1 left to right: broken square stone pillar stump; angular stone rubble pile; two battered wooden crates; two iron-bound wooden barrels. Row 2: narrow iron wall sconce with lit orange torch; narrow iron wall sconce unlit; low round iron brazier lit; low round iron brazier with cold charcoal. Row 3: squat stone sarcophagus with closed lid; damaged stone altar; rusty iron cage; toppled timber barricade. Row 4: low bone and skull pile; blue-grey ore rock cluster; squat weathered stone statue; small candle cluster with wax drips. Match visual weight and grey stone material to reference; avoid photorealism, smooth vectors, cartoon thick outlines, elaborate illustrations, oversized flame halos. Export transparent PNG.
terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production top-down dungeon terrain texture atlas. ONE square image, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, all equal square cells, textures fill every cell edge to edge, zero gutters/borders/labels/text. Reference attached is style and pixel density only: same restrained charcoal stone dungeon, crisp chunky pixel clusters readable at logical32px. Flat orthographic ground plane, no perspective blocks or props. Each cell is a separate repeatable terrain material; quiet edges and low-frequency detail, no frames. Row1 four dark desaturated blue water variations: still shallow water with submerged stone; same with tiny ripple; deeper dark water; same with scattered small ripples. Row2 four scorched fire terrain variations: sparse amber embers on black stone; low orange burning cracks; active low flame patches over charred stone; glowing molten fissures in dark basalt. Fire contained to ground tile, no tall fireballs. Row3: slick green-grey mossy stone; muddy wet gravel; dark poisonous olive sludge; dark purple corrupted stone cracks. Row4: pale blue frosted stone; cracked blue ice; ash-covered stone; rusted metal floor grating. Muted colours, warm amber strongest only in fire. NO translucent/checkerboard ground. High quality sprite texture sheet, not scene or contact sheet with gaps.
themes: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production dark fantasy dungeon MATERIAL atlas. Generate ONE square 4x4 exact equal-cell image, no gutters, no labels/text/borders. Attached wall and floor images are structural references. Every row a different theme. Columns 1 and 2: two matching FLAT top-down flagstone floor textures filling entire cell. Column3: exactly the same wall geometry in ALL four rows and as reference image1 top-left quadrant: horizontal stone coping band occupies top25% of square, straight front-facing 3 courses of rectangular masonry fill lower75%, no end caps, no arch, no pillars, horizontal lines absolutely straight. Column4: flat top-down wall mass made of broad stone blocks, matching that row. These are material samples for a runtime renderer that builds connected vertical and horizontal walls, NOT prebuilt room images. Row1 flooded crypt: desaturated dark teal-grey masonry, sparse damp moss in joints. Row2 abandoned mine: desaturated warm brown slate masonry, faint iron staining, no timber beams. Row3 burnt fortress: black basalt masonry, ash, tiny restrained ember cracks, no flames. Row4 frozen ruin: cold blue-grey masonry, frost edging and sparse ice cracks. Same block sizes, perspective, coping width, lighting and pixel scale across all four rows; ONLY materials/palette vary. Crisp chunky pixel art matching provided references, logical32px readability, dark fantasy, subdued floor contrast. No photorealism, no perspective/isometric floor diamonds, no complete walls/rooms, no objects.
